Duplicate tag keys produced HTTP 500 InternalFailure once; do not generalize it as a deterministic validation contract.

Known+unknown inputs partially succeed with unknown rule ErrorCode string 400 and Message Unknown rule. Duplicate same-rule documents produce duplicate target entries. ClientID exact 24-character nonhex input accepted; short/empty rejected. Stale/future/epoch timestamps and sampled/borrow counts exceeding requests were accepted, not proof that all their counts were projected. Twenty-six documents rejected. Required fields and count boundaries retain exact individual native errors.

Targets initially contained explicit null Interval/ReservoirQuota/ReservoirQuotaTTL, later interval 10 and TTL roughly 300 seconds after response. Observed allocations ranged from zero to the then-configured reservoir, with independent/repeated clients and time affecting outputs. Multi-rule target order varied. Do not derive deterministic allocation from samples. A clean report 73 requests/17 sampled/1 borrowed was visible in the next summary window, then later summaries returned zero; summaries are not a cumulative ledger.

Explicit expiry anchor happened to return null; prior nonnull TTL is retained separately. A call after prior TTL returned null quota fields, not proof of a server-side hard deletion deadline. Targets lagged updated rule rate and deletion while GetSamplingRules reflected current state. LastRuleModification likewise lagged. No fixed convergence bound is inferred.

Rule-ARN-only permission denied three sampling discovery/statistics APIs but allowed ListTagsForResource on that ARN. ResourceTag/Owner, RequestTag/Approved and TagKeys conditions controlled owned mutations. CreateSamplingRule with tags required TagResource permission as well as create permission: create-only session denied even matching Owner; matching create+tag session succeeded. Explicit deny blocked target read and deletion.

GetSamplingRules and GetSamplingStatisticSummaries were Management/readOnly=true; Create/Update/DeleteSamplingRule Management/readOnly=false. GetSamplingTargets was Data/readOnly=true with resources type AWS::XRay::Trace and no ARN; request statistics documents were retained, responseElements null. Successful and IAM-denied requests were captured and correlated by requestID.

limitations: No account-wide rule quota exhaustion: at most five owned rules concurrently; tested bounded per-request/tag/attribute limits only.

No real workload is sampled: exact unique ServiceName, .invalid Host and unique URLPath cannot match production requests. This is native control/SDK-consumer protocol evidence, not a claim about invented service spans or successful deserialization.
Allocation randomness, per-backend cache/convergence and aggregation window scheduling remain unresolved; retain observed values and nulls rather than inventing a deterministic quota algorithm.
An absence of a CloudTrail record in this bounded delivery window does not prove an API is unaudited.
